name: Mylio Photos Plus
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Mylio Photos Plus, catalog local and network photos with duplicates, tags, and device-aware storage. The hard boundary is multi-device private sync, face recognition, vault strategy, and polished photo workflow, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
